de ltar ngan song las thon nas kyang lkugs pa dang*/ kla klo la sogs par skyes nas yun ring por dal 'byor gyi mi lus mi thob ste/ slob spring las/ brgya la sdig gnas dmyal ba dag las thar na yang*// 'jig rten 'gro ba mtha' yas bye ba ches rnams su// mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed par dka' ba nyid// gal te kla klo dmyal ba'i srung dang spyod mtshungs sam// zhes gsungs pa nyid do// gsum pa dge ba'i las 'bras bstan pa ni/ chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis/ dge ba bcu po 'di dag ni mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa thams cad kyi rgyu yin pas na sangs rgyas kyi slob ma dag gis 'di ltar bslab par bya'o// de la dge ba bcu gang zhe na/ lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum ste/ srog mi gcod pa dang*/ ma byin par mi len pa dang*/ 'dod pas log par mi g.yem pa'o// ngag gi las ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ rdzun mi smra ba dang*/ phra ma mi smra ba dang*/ tshig rtsub po mi smra ba dang*/ tshig 'khyal ba mi smra ba'o// yid kyi las rnam pa gsum ste/ brnab sems spang ba dang*/ gnod sems spang ba dang*/ log par lta ba spang ba'o// de yang mi dge ba bcu spangs pa ni dge ba bcu yin pas zhes gsungs so// de ltar dge ba bcu la 'bad par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu'ang*/ rnam smin rgyu mthun bdag 'bras gsum dang*/ rgyu mthun la'ang myong byed kyi rgyu mthun gnyis sogs sngar bshad pa dang cha 'dra ba las/ srog gcod spangs pa lta bu la rnam smin ni mtho ris kyi lha mi// myong ba rgyu mthun tshe ring zhing nad med pa/ byed pa rgyu mthun skye ba'i phreng bar gzhan gyi srog gcod pa la ngang gis mi 'jug pa/ bdag 'bras rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs gzi byin che zhing nad kyi gnod pa nyung ba sogs/ sngar bshad pa'i ldog phyogs rnams dang*/ rim par bsgrigs pas shes la/ de ltar mi dge ba bcu spong ba ni/ gtso bor tshul khrims kyi phyogs yin zhing*/

gzhan yang sbyin pa dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus la sogs pa yang ste/ dbu ma 'jug par/ 'gro ba 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing*// mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la// longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas// thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do// zhes dang*/ shes rab brgya par/ gang la bzod pa'i rang bzhin chus// khro ba'i me ni zhi byed pa// 'dul ba'i thabs kyi mchog yod pa// de la dgra rnams ga la sdang*// zhes dang*/ phyir rjes su ni lta ba dang*// bag yod khong khro med pa dang*// brtson 'grus brtan zhing mi g.yel ba'i// mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas// zhes phan yon dang bcas te bstan to// mdor na dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin yang mthong chos myong 'gyur/ skye ba phyi ma lan grangs gzhan myong*/ nges med sogs sngar bshad dang cha 'dra la/ mthong chos ni zhing las byed pa'i bram zes de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jam gsol ba'i 'phral la zhing gi myu gu lo 'bras kun gser du byung ba lta bu sbyin 'bras kyis mtshon nas phal cher la go bar nus shing*/ dge ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa phyogs tsam legs byas la spro ba bskyed phyir bshad na/ btsun pa chen po chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis/ rtag tu g.yo dang sgyu spyod cing*// sdig pa dag ni ma byas la// 'thab la dga' zhing sbyin byed pa// de ni lha min dbang phyug 'gyur// gang zhig bdag bde mi 'dod cing*// yongs su bzung la mi dga' ba// de ni gza' rnams dag gi mchog /rgyal chen bzhi pa nyid du 'gyur// pha ma pha tshan gtso bo la// bkur byed stong ldan bzod par ldan// 'thab mo la ni dga' ba gang*// de ni sum cu rtsa gsum skye// rtsod la mi dga' 'thab mo la// yid ni dga' bar mi byed la// gcig tu dge la brtson pa ni// de dag 'thab bral nyid du 'gro// thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang*// shes rab ldan zhing thar pa 'dod// yon tan rnams la dga' ba'i mi// de dag dga' ldan nye bar 'gro// mi gang rang nyid dul ba la// zhugs shing tshul khrims 'bogs pa la// spro ba che dang ldan pa de// gdon mi za bar 'phrul dgar 'gro// sems can gang zhig dman min mchog

/sbyin dang dul dang yang dag sdom// phul byung yon tan ldan gyur de// nges par gzhan phrul dbang byed 'gro// zhes dang*/ dpa' bos/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs gsol ba// dang po mya ngan sel bar byed// rtsod pa kun spangs mthong na dga'// skal ldan gter tshogs dpal dang ldan// lus stobs ldan zhing snyan pa dang*// gzi brjid ldan zhing gzugs mdzes pa// gsung rab kun la mkhas 'gyur zhing*// dbang po'i rta ni thams cad thul// blo ldan stobs dang ldan par 'gyur// bcom ldan sku gzugs mchod rten la// phra rabs rdul ni ji snyed sol// de snyed sa 'og sa steng 'dir// de snyed rgyal po nges par 'gyur// gzugs dang gzugs med ting 'dzin grub// thams cad bde bar ma lus spyod// mtha' mar skye ba'i rgyud spangs nas// de dag byang chub go 'phang thob// bde gshegs sku gzugs bzhengs gsol ba// mtshan bzang gis brgyan 'khor los sgyur// gang gis chos kyi sbyin byed cing*// dri ba dang ni nyan pa dang*// rtag tu de dag sems nyid dang*// gal te yang dag bsgom byed na// skye ba dran pa rtag tu thob// ces dang*/ me tog bzang pos dge 'dun la// rab tu 'thor zhing mchod byed pa// brgya byin las lhag longs spyod ldan// sogs dang*/ mdor na/ gang yang 'khor los sgyur ba mchog /bu ni dpa' ba stong dang ldan// rgya mtsho'i mtshams kyi sa la dbang*// de dag bsod nams rin po che'i// 'bras bu yangs pa chen po yin// sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la 'dug /lha dang lha dbang rtag phyag 'tshal// brjid kyis 'khor rnams zil gyis gnon// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snang byed pa// de dag nyid kyang bsod nams las// gang la lha klu lha min sbrul// dri za gnod sbyin mi'am ci// mchog tu gyur pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// rtag tu lha dbang mchod byed pa// de ni bsod nams rin po che'i// 'bras bu yangs pa chen po yin// dang*/

'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba na// bsod nams gcig po mchog yin te// rjes su 'gro zhing bde ba 'char// bsod nams gzhan gyis 'phrog mi nus// zhes sogs gsungs la/ gzhan yang mtho ris kyi khyad par ni yon tan bdun dang ldan pa yin la/ bdun po'ang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang*// gzugs dang skal ba bzang dang rigs// nor dang shes rab dag dang bdun// yon tan mdo sde dag las gsungs// zhes gsungs la// de dag so so'i rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba'i las kyang*/ de nyid kyis/ gsod par tshud pa legs btang dang*// de bzhin srog gi phan gdags shing*// srog chags 'tshe ba las bzlog pas// tshe ring ba ni thob par 'gyur// nad pa'i bsnyen bkur byas sman pa// sman ni rab tu sbyin pa dang*// srog chags bong ba dbyig sogs kyis// 'tshe ba med las nad med yin// khro ba med la brtan pa dang*// rgyan byin pa yis gzugs bzang nyid// phrag dog med pa'i 'bras bu ni// skal ba bzang por yongs su bshad// dam pa mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas// nga rgyal spangs pas rigs mthor 'gyur// sbyin byed brku ba las ldog pas// longs spyod phun sum tshogs thob 'gyur// dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhes// yang dag dri la brtson pa dang*// chos kyi bstan bcos sbyin pa yis// blo gros rgya chen thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'o// bzhi pa 'jug ldog gi spyod pa la bslab dgos par bstan pa ni// de ltar las 'bras kyi go babs phyogs tsam bshad pas mtshon par nges pa rnyed pa'i 'dor len ma byas na tshe 'di'am shi ba'i 'og tu mi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thog tu 'bab pas blang dor nan gyis bya dgos la/ de yang chos byed 'dod kyi bsam pa lhang nge ba dang*/ chos bya blo'i sbyor ba tshab tshub yod kyang*/ gnad ma shes na chos lam du mi 'gro ba mang du snang ste/ chos kyi mthun rkyen du bsam pa'i zas gos longs spyod sogs kyis chog mi shes par log 'tshos sdig gsog cing 'dod pa bsod nams kyi mthar gol nas log par ltung ba dang*/

yang 'ga' zhig lto gos gtam gsum la gyong bkur ba'i dka' spyad drag po byas kyang gnad ma zin par ngal zhing dub pa'i mthar lhung ba yang snang ste lam du 'gro ba dka'/ des na chos lam du 'gro ba la thog mar las 'bras la yid ches kyis 'dor len byed pa zhig gnad du che ste/ rang 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe zas gos longs spyod nye 'brel 'khor g.yog kun shul du bzhag nas gcig pur 'gro ba na yang*/ las dge sdig gi rnam smin 'di lus dang grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dus kyi nyen te rgyal po 'chi ba'i tshe// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu bdag ni gang dang gar 'gro ba// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// zhes dang*/ mdo sde dang 'dul ba'i sde snod tshig mthun par/ skye bo 'di dag ni las kyi skye gnas pa/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ las bdag gir byed pa yin// zhes dang*/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi za ba yin// zhes dang*/ mdo sde las brgya las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'// tshogs shing dus la babs pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bshes spring las/ khyod kyis bram ze dge slong lha dang ni// mgron dang yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang*// 'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyi ste// dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug tu/ re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la'ang*// mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das// de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi zad gang yin mdun na gnas// zhes dang*/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bram ze rnams ni dge sdig dag /byin pa len bzhin 'pho bar smra// khyod kyis byas chud mi za dang*// ma byas pa dang 'phrad med gsungs// zhes sogs gsungs te/ rang don du byas pa'i sdig pa rang gis khur bar ma zad gzhan don du byas na'ang de dag gi rnam smin la bgo bsha' byas nas khur grogs byed pa lta bu min par rang kho nas myong bar 'gyur bas na sdig pa'i las phra rags thams cad dug dang mi gtsang ba'am sbrul gdug pa ltar ya nga ba dang*/

skyug bro ba dang 'jigs su rung bar bltas nas dor zhing*/ dge ba'i phyogs phra mo'ang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po bzhin phyi shol med par lag tu len cing len par 'dun dgos te/ bshes spring las// gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa der// ngan skyugs 'phyag par byed pa de bas ni// gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /byed pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug tu/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba thob gyur nas// bdag gi dge goms ma byas na// de las blun pa gzhan med de// de las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do// dmyal me bzod dka' yun ring du// bdag gi lus 'di bsregs gyur na// 'gyod pa 'ba' zhig me 'bar bas// sems gdung 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes dang*/ bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni// mi yi lus kyang thob mi 'gyur// mi lus thob par ma gyur na// sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med// ces gsungs pa dran par byas nas/ dran pas 'dor len ma 'chol bar bya la/ gzhan yang dper na mang po skyobs par bsam pas gcig gi srog gcod pa lta bu rgyu dus kyi bsam pas dge ba kho na yin la/ sbyor dus su zhe sdang cung zad skyes na mi dge ba ste/ las de la kun slong dkar nag gnyis char res 'jog tu tshang bas dge ba shas che ba'i 'dres ma dang*/ mang po zhig gsod par bsam pas ma chags pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba lta bu sdig shas che ba'i 'dres ma ste/ de dag la rgyu dus dang sbyor dus kyi kun slong so so'i rnam smin 'byin kyang snga ma stobs che la/ sems can mang po phan bde la bkod pa dang mang po srog dang phral bar byas pa'i bdag 'bras kyang so sor 'byung la/ spyir 'dres ma'i las de dag kyang spang byar bshad mod/ 'on kyang theg chen pas rgyu 'bras su dge ba la sbyor skabs mi dge ba'i rnam par 'byung yang rang gzhan gyi phan bde rgya chen po nges par mthong nas bsgrub par ded dpon snying stobs can gyis tshong pa g.yon can brkums pa bzhin te/

'phags pa lhas/ bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' yis// dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba// thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te// gang phyir sems de gtso ba'i phyir// zhes gsungs pas so// lnga pa spel sbyangs phyogs tsam bshad pa ni// de yang theg pa thun mongs par rang rgyud la ngan song du skye nges kyi las yod na tshe 'di la sbyor lam bzod pa tsam yang thob pa'i nus pa med/ 'dod khams su skye ba'i las yod na// 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba'i 'bras bu thob nus med pa sogs/ spyir khams gsum gang rung du skye nges kyi las yod na/ tshe 'di la 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon las thar pa'i nus pa med pas/ las ngan pa phyin chad mi gsog par bsdam pa dang*/ sngar byas la 'gyod tshangs drag pos bshags par rigs te/ mdzod las/ bzod dang phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom// thob pa la gegs shin tu byed// ces 'byung*/ de lta na tshe rabs thog med nas mthong chos la myong 'gyur sogs nges pa'i las ni ji snyed cig bsags/ da ji ltar byas kyang 'khor ba las thar pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam blo bag 'khum pa'ang srid na// de tsam 'khum mi dgos te/ rang re'i ston pas bka' sde snod mang por nges pa'i las sogs rnam grangs du ma gsungs pa de/ theg pa 'og ma dag gis sgra ji bzhin par khas len kyang theg pa chen po'i skabs 'dir/ de dag gtso che ba'am/ spyir btang tsam yin gyi/ dmigs bsal mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ nges pa'i las su bgrang ba'i mtshams med byas pa sogs kyang snying stobs chen pos bshags sdom dang gnyen po dam chos zab mo la 'bad na las nyon de kun dag par byed nus pa ni/ bshes spring las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las// phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang*// zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te// dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin// zhes pa ltar gyis na/ skyabs yul dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar sngar byas la 'gyod pa drag po/

phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'i sdom sems ldan pas/ sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes spyod 'jug las 'byung ba 'di ltar ngag tu yang brjod cing*/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan// de dag thams cad spyan snga na// bdag ni rtag par gnas so zhes// de ltar bsam nas ngo tsha dang*// gus dang 'jigs ldan de ltar mnos// de ni sangs rgyas rjes dran pa'ang*// de la yang dang yang du 'byung*// zhes dang*// tha mal nad kyis btab pa dang*// sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na// 'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi// nad kyi rtag btab smos ci dgos// de bas sman pa thams cad mkhyen// zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yis// bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni// shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas// zhes gsungs pa sogs yang yang dran pas sdom sems brtan po bskyed cing*/ de yang rang rgyud la rgyun du brtag dpyad 'jug pa gal che ste/ rgyal sras bzang po dpal gyis/ rang gi skyon la rang gis ma brtag na// chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas// dus rnams kun tu rang gi 'khrul pa la// brtags nas spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// zhes gsungs pas so// de bzhin dge ba'i las ji ltar spyad pa thams cad theg pa chen po pa'i lugs kyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can byang chub chen po la reg pa'i phyir bsngo ba bzhin gyis spel bar bya ste/ de ltar bgyis pas ni byang chub snying por 'dug gi bar du dge rtsa mi 'dzad par ma zad gong du 'phel la/ gnas skabs su mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor rgya chen nyams su myong ba'ang 'gro la phan bde'i snying po can du 'char ba yin te/ 'bras lo legs na phub sogs zhar la 'byung ba lta bu yin no// de ltar las 'bras bsam pa 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/

dbu ma rin chen 'phreng ba las/ 'dun dang zhe sdang 'jigs pa dang*// rmongs pas gang zhig chos mi 'da'// de ni dad pa can zhes bya// nges par legs pa'i snod mchog yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ༈ //bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bstan pa'i khrid la/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du bstan pa/ bye brag sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bshad pa/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa/ sdug bsngal de ldan gyi 'khor ba las nges par thar ba'i thabs la 'bad par gdams pa ste lnga las/ dang po spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du bstan pa ni/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs shing*/ byams mgon gyis/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med// 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// ces dang*/ bshes spring las/ 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang*// dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba rnams dag tu// skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni// gnod pa du ma'i gnod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod// ces dang*/ mngal 'jug gi mdo las/ kye ma kyi hud srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di ni 'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba/ shin tu 'bar ba/ mchog tu 'bar ba yin pas/ sems can 'ga' tsam yang des ma btses pa med do// rab tu 'bar bar byed pa'i me gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi me dang*/ skye ba dang rga ba dang 'chi ba'i me dang*/ mya ngan dang*/ smre sngags 'don pa dang*/ yid mi bde ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa'i me dag gi rtag tu bsreg cing 'bar bar byed pas/ 'ga' tsam yang de las thar pa med do// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa bye brag sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/

de yang spyir na 'bras tsha ba'i steng du tsha chu btab pa'i 'gyur byed kyi reg pa dang 'phrad pas sdug bsngal cher song ba lta bu zhig ste/ de nyid kho nas kyang 'gro ba drug gam lnga po kun la khyab pa las/ dang por ngan song gi sdug bsngal phyogs tsam bshad na/ dmyal ba la tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe ba dang*/ nye 'khor ba ste dmyal khams bco brgyad yod pa las/ tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ spyi khyab tu 'og thams cad lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi/ 'khor yug lcags bsregs kyi ra ba/ steng 'og me lce kun tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa yin la/ de las dang po ni/ gnas der dmyal srung gi gshin rje khro zhing rngam pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa mang pos bdas te phan tshun 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal nyam thag pa'i ngang nas rang lus dum bur gtub ste sdug bsngal gyi ngang du brgyal ba dang*/ nam mkha' nas yang sos par gyur cig ces bsgrags pa'i mod la lus sngar bzhin sos la/ yang sngar lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba yang sos/ dmyal srung rnams kyis thig chen brgyad dang bcu drug sogs btab ste/ lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas gshog pa dang*/ sta res gtub pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ cung zad brgyal ba dang sos te sngar bzhin rgyun mi chad pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba thig nag /lcags kyi ri bo g.yag lug ma he seng ge sogs kyi gdong pa can me 'bar ba'i bar du rang dbang med par tshud de phye mar 'thag pas sdug bsngal ba bsdus 'joms/ lcags khang sgo med me 'bar ba'i dbus na sdug bsngal gyis ngu 'bod lhang lhang 'debs pa ngu 'bod/ lcags khang sgo med nyis rim gyi nang du me 'bar bas tshig pa'i smre sngags ches cher sgrog pa ngu 'bod chen po/ dmyal srung rnams kyis lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar bas 'phongs dang spyi bo'i bar tal mar phug ste dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas me lce 'bar ba dang*/ lus ril por khro chu khol ma'i nang du 'tshod pa tsha ba/

gsal shing 'bar bzhin pa rtse mo gsum pas bshang lam nas bug ste dbus ma spyi bo dang g.yas g.yon 'phrag pa nas thon pa dang*/ lcags bsregs leb mos lus la snam bu ltar dkri ba dang*/ khro chu'i nang du tshod pa na sha khrag rnams zhig ste keng rus ltar 'gro ba rab tu tsha ba/ phyogs mtshams kun nas me 'bar bas lus dang me dbyer med pa lta bu'i tshul gyis ngu ba'i skad thos pa tsam las lus mi mngon pa'i sdug bsngal 'khor yug tu myong ba mnar med/ tshe tshad ni/ mngon par/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// des na de dag rnams kyi tshe// 'dod lha'i tshe dang mnyam pa yin// rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni// bar gyi bskal pa'o zhes pa ltar te/ mi'i lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig yin zhing*/ de 'dra sum cu la de dag gi zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo rer byas pa'i lo lnga brgya la rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i tshe tshad yin la/ tshe tshad de yang sos pa'i nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i de sum cu la zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis lor byas pa'i rang lo de 'dra lnga brgya yang sos pa'i tshe tshad/ de la mi lo khrag khrig gcig ther 'bum chen po drug dang ther 'bum gnyis/ gzhan rnams rim gyis ldab 'phar du 'gyur la/ rab tu tsha ba bar bskal phyed dang*/ mnar med bar bskal gcig tu sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'o// gzhan yang tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal ba'i yan lag tu rang rang gi lte ba'i gnas kyi rwa ba las 'das shing thar pa na/ phyogs bzhir 'khor yug tu me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gris gtams pa'i thang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal/ shal ma li'i sdong po/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med rnams la lo grangs mang por sdug bsngal myong ste/ de yang thog mar thang chen po dmar lam me ba zhig 'dug snyam phyin pas me ma mur gyi 'obs la rkang pa'i long bu man nub ba dang*/

pus mo man dang*/ rked pa man dang*/ mgrin pa man nub pa la yun ring po'i bar du phyin pas/ lus bteg tshe sha'u sos kyang*/ me des reg pa'i tshe rus pa khrol khrol 'gro ba de res 'jog gi sdug bsngal nyam thag pa myong ba dang*/ de nas dri nga zhing btsog pa'i ro myags kyi 'dam las thar mi nus bzhin du brgal dgos pa dang*/ brgal ba'i tshe dmyal ba'i bya lus ser zhing mgo nag pas lus thal byung du phug ste sdug bsngal bzod brlag med pa lo mang po'i bar du myong*/ de las thar te phyin pas ne'u sing sngon po lta bu mthong nas bsnyegs pa na/ spu gris gtams pa'i thang chen po rkang pa la sogs pa rbad rbad gtub cing*/ 'gyel ba na lus kyang dum bur gtub pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ yang lo ma'i nags stug po zhig mthong nas bsnyegs pa na/ las kyi rlung chen po langs te/ nags kyi lo ma ral gri so gnyis par gyur pas lus dbang med du gtub pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ yang phyin pas ri chen po zhig mthong nas der bsnyegs pas/ ri de yi rtsa ba nas dmyal ba'i khyi sre bo 'jigs su rung bas gson por za ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ ri de'i rtse mo nas rang chags yul gyi skyes pa bud med gang yang rung bas rang ming nas 'bod pa'i skad lhang nge thos nas 'gro bar brtsams pas/ shal ma li'i lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa sogs rtse mo thur du bstan pas lus tshag ma ltar phug pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ rtser sleb tsa na chags yul ni gar song med pa'i dmyal ba'i bya khra mchu rnon gyis mig 'tshog pa dang*/ klad pa bldag pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong zhing*/ yang chags yul des ri'i rtsa ba nas 'bod pa'i sgra lhang nge ba thos nas 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ lcags kyi tsher ma rnams kyi rtse gyen la bstan te lus thams cad 'bigs pa'i sdug bsngal bzod glag med pa myong la/

mtshon cha'i rigs kyi sdug bsngal gsum po de las thar te phyin pa na/ chu chen po gya gyur 'gro ba la brgal bar brtsams pas/ thal tshan nam 'gyur byed kyi chu bo rab med ces bya ba/ ngo bo thal ba tshan mo la rnam pa chu'i dbyibs can/ lus thams cad rus pa'i bar du tshig pa'i ngang nas mi thar bzhin du brgal dgos pa dang*/ phar 'gram du slebs par nye ba na dmyal srung mtshon cha thogs pas bsrungs te phar log tshur log gi ngang la lus sems tshor ba sdug bsngal drag pos non bzhin du las de ma zad par sdug bsngal myong dgos te/ brgyad po re re'i phyogs bzhir yang bzhi bzhi yod pas bcu drug nye 'khor ba zhes bya'o// grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad ni/ spyi khyab kyi gnas mtha' thams cad gangs ri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ 'og thams cad kha ba'i thang dang 'khyag rom gyi gcong zab mo/ steng nas kha ba bu yug 'tshub ste rlung grang mo'i reg byas btsub pa/ snang ba gsal byed kyi rkyen cung zad kyang med de mun pa mun nag tu 'thibs/ dro ba'i dngos po skyibs su yib pa'am/ bgo ba'i gos ni lhan pa tsam yang med/ pha 'bod ma 'bod byas kyang skyo grogs sam skyob mkhan tsam med de/ de la chu bar can ni kha ba'i bu yug chen po rlung gis phyogs bzhi nas btab ste lus la phog pas chu bur byung zhing 'khums pa'o// chu bur rdol ba can ni de las rnag khrag 'dzag pa'o// a chu zer ba ni sdug bsngal cher song bas skad kyi gdangs drag por 'don pa'o// kyi hud zer ba ni sdug bsngal de bas cher song bas skad kyi gdangs chag ste rkan gyi phug nas 'don pa'o// so tham tham pa ni sdug bsngal sngar las je cher 'phel bas skad 'don ma nus par so tham tham byed pa'o// ut+pal ltar gas pa ni rlung chen pos btab pas kha dog sngo zhing ser chung phra mo kha drug tu gas pa'o// pad+ma ltar gas pa ni pags pa sngon po rnams zhus te sha'u dmar hu re ba tshal pa bcur gas pa'o// pad+ma ltar cher gas pa mdog sngon ma ltar la ser kha brgya'am de bas kyang mang ba ste/

skyes rabs las/ med par lta ba skye ba phyi ma la// gnas pa de na mun nag grang rlung ldang*// de ni rus pa'ang 'jig pa'i nad slong na// bdag la phan 'dod su zhig de ru 'jug /ces dang*/ slob spring las/ lhag pa dpe med rus pa la yang thim pa yis// lus sbreb 'dar shad bskur nas gum gum por 'dug pa// chu bur brgya byung rdol ba las skyes srog chags kyis// grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o 'dod 'bod// ces gsungs/ tshe tshad kyang*/ til rdzang nang nas lo brgya bzhin// til re phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur// zhes pa/ ma gha ngha'i bre bo che'i khal brgyad bcu 'gro ba'i til gyi bang ba nas lo brgya brgya na til re phyung bas de zad pa'i tshe chu bur can gyi tshe tshad du bshad la/ rim pas nyi shu 'gyur ro// nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba zhes pa ni/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dngos dang*/ nye 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag po lta bu ma yin yang*/ dmyal ba'i gnas der dmyal srung rnams kyis dmyal ba'i zangs mo cher 'tshod pa dang*/ lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba dang khro chu khol ma khar snyod pa dang*/ lcags bsregs kyi leb mor lus sgril ba dang*/ lcags bsregs kyi 'khyud mos sdom pa dang*/ lce la thong gshol gyis rmos su rmos pa sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa sogs kyang nyi tshe bar gtogs pa ste/ nyin par gnas khang yid du 'ong bar grogs mdzes mas glu gar sogs 'dod pa'i rtse dga' la rol zhing*/ nyi ma nub mtshams nas yid du 'ong ba'i gnas grogs sogs mi snang bar/ gnas khang dri nga bar grogs rang la gnod pa'i gshed ma dang*/ rang sha za ba'i khyi sogs kyis gtses nas sdug bsngal des drag po myong ba nyin mo bslab pa bsrungs shing mtshan mo byi byas pa'i rnam smin dang*/

nyin mtshan go ldog gi sdug bsngal myong ba nyin mo srog gcod kyi bshan pa dang*/ mtshan mo bslab pa bsrungs shing dge ba spyad pa'i rnam smin du bshad pa mdo sde las mang du 'byung ba ltar yin la/ mdor na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ji ltar chung yang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal che ba'i tshad kyis phyogs char phyin nus pa ma yin te/ bshes springs las/ 'di na nyin cig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*// 'ol yang mi bgyid char yang mi phod do// zhes gsungs/ de yang bde ba kun gyi nang nas zag pa zad pa'i bde ba che la/ sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na yang spyir dmyal ba/ sgos mnar med pa sdug bsngal che ba yin pas/ de nyid las/ bde ba kun gyi nang na sred zad pa'i// bde ba bdag por bgyid pa ji lta ba// de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na yang*// mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzod// ces pas mtshon pa'o// ngan 'gro yi dwags sam gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal yang*/ 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya na yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya bya ba khang rul zhig po lta bu la/ ri klungs thams cad chu dang rtsi shing nags tshal sogs yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po ci yang med pas se thang nge ba/ yid shin tu skyo ba bskyed pa'i gnas der yod pa ni byings che ba yin la/ kha 'thor ba ni lha mi'i yul na'ang yod par grags/ de la rigs sum cu so drug sogs bshad kyang*/ gtso che ba phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can/ sgrib can gyi sgrib pa can te bzhi/ de yang zas skom gyi longs spyod gang yang mi rnyed par bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal kho na myong ba ni phyi yul rkyen gyis longs spyod la gegs byed pas phyi'i sgrib can/ kha khab mig tsam la mgrin pa rta rnga tsam/

yan lag 'jag ma tsam la lto ba ri'i ljongs tsam/ bza' btung sogs longs spyod gtan nas mi rnyed cing*/ brgya la rnyed kyang khar mi tshud/ tshud kyang mgrin pa la mi thar/ gal te thar yang lto ba mi khengs par bkres skom gyis nyen pa'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong ba nang lus kyis gegs byed pa'i phyir nang gi sgrib pa can te/ bshes spring las/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri yi ljongs tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gi nar bor ba cung zad kyang*// 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so// zhes gsungs/ yang zas skom cung zad rnyed na khong du sleb pa dang mer 'bar bas bkres skom mi sel ba'i khar/ mer 'bar bas lus tshig pa'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ bzas skom nyid kyis gegs byed pa'i phyir zas sgrib can dang*/ kha cig zas skom yod kyang longs spyad dbang med pa sgrib can gyi sgrib pa can no// gzhan yang bshes spring las/ yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni// zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang*// ljon shing 'bras bu med gyur de dag gis// bltas pa tsam gyis chu klung skam par 'gyur// zhes pa ltar sos ka zla zer gyi reg bya'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi 'od kyi reg bya yang grang bar snang la/ ljon shing 'bras bu can yod kyang bltas ma thag tu 'bras bu thams cad khung med du yal ba dang*/ chu klung chen po rgyang nas mthong yang der phyin pa na/ chu skam ste ngam grog skya sing nge bar 'char ba'am/ mtshon cha thogs pas bsrung ba'am rnag khrag dang skra shad sogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang nags klung nyams dga' ba dag tu phyin na nags tshal mes bsregs pa dang*/ bsil bar 'dod nas gangs can du phyin na yang bye tshan gyi khu ba rlung dmar gyis 'tshubs pa dang*/ char sprin las lcags mda'i char pa dud pa 'thul zhing me 'dag dang me'i tshwa tshwa rdo rje'i pha bong rnams lus la 'bab pa sogs te/

slob spring las/ 'di la sna tshogs 'di kun phyin ci log tu snang*/ zhes so// tshe tshad ni mi'i zla ba re la zhag cig tu brtsis pa'i lo lnga brgyar gnas pa sogs bshad do/ des na bshes spring las/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yi// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi chod pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi zad bsten 'tshal lo// zhes so// dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyi dbang du byas na/ dud 'gro la byings na gnas pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba gnyis su sa sde las bshad pa'i byings na gnas pa ni/ ri rab kyi chu mtshams man chad kyi khongs su yod de lus kyi che chung sogs ma nges pa sna tshogs 'bru yi phung po ltar spungs pa rnams/ che bas chung ba za zhing*/ chung bas che ba 'bug pa dang*/ gnas dang bza' btung grogs sogs gang la'ang nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ gling bar gyi mun pa mun nag la gnas pa rnams ni rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ rang sha rang gis za ba sogs dang*/ klu'i rigs rnams ni bye tshan gyi char lus la yang yang du 'bebs pas sha rus bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa chen po dang bcas shing*/ kha 'thor ba'i rigs la ri dwags rnams ni ling pa khyi dang gcan gzan bya khra klag la sogs pas dbang med du ded cing*/ 'jigs skrag gi ngang nas srog chad pa sogs dang*/ bdag tu bzung ba rnams kyang bkol brtsog sogs byas mthar srog gcod pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ srog chags phra mo rnams ni rkyen cung zad tsam gyis 'chi ba sogs dang*/ dud 'gro spyi khyab glen cing rmongs pa sogs tshad med pa'i sdug bsngal can te/ bshes spring las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang*// bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi zad pa// zhes dang*/

kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang pags pa'i phyir du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan dag lag pa rdog pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyu btab pas btab ste bkol// zhes gsungs te/ de ltar na ngan 'gro gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhib tu bsams pa kho nas kyang snying rlung bslong ba'i gnas yin na nyams su myong ba ni ji ltar bzod par nus zhes legs par bsam dgos la/ de yang spyir mi dge ba/ sgos zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pas dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gro zhes sam gsum gas kyang gsum gar 'phen pa las nus che chung gis yin la/ de lta'i las 'bras kyi tshul cung zad zhib pa sngar bshad zin ltar yin la/ rang rgyud la zhib mor bsams na de der skye nges kyi las tshul tshe 'dir sngar phan bsags pa yod nges shing*/ gal te med kyang tshe rabs snga ma rnams su bsgrubs pa ni med mi srid pa yin pas sang skye ba phyi ma'am/ de'i yang phyi ma tsam du ngan song gi gnas de dag tu skye ba la tshegs med pas dran pa dang dran min du sngar byas bshags shing phyin chad mi bgyid pa'i sdom 'dun bskyed pa cis kyang gal che ba yin/ de ltar na ngan 'gro gsum sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba bden mod bde 'gror skyes na bde ba 'ba' zhig go snyam pa la/ de dag kyang sdug bsngal las mi 'da' ba'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ de la mi rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ spyir skye gnas bzhir yod kyang mngal skyes gtso che ba la/ slob spring las/ shin tu mi bzad dri nga mi gtsang gcer bas 'gag /rab tu dog pa mun nag 'thib por 'dug pa yi// mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas// lus kyang bskum la sdug bsngal chen po brnag dgos so// zhes skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ rgya che rol pa'i mdo las/ rga bas gzugs sdug gzugs mi sdug par byed// rga bas gzi brjid 'phrog cing mthu stobs 'phrog

/rga bas bde ba 'phrog cing brnyas par byed// rga bas 'chi byed rga bas mdangs kyang 'phrog /ces rgas pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ de nyid las/ dper na dgun smad rlung dang kha ba ches// rtsa shing gel pa nags sman mdangs kyang 'phrog /de ltar nad 'dis 'gro ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing*// dbang po zungs dang stobs ni nyams par byed// ces na ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'chi dang 'pho dang 'chi 'pho dus byed pa// 'phongs shing sdug pa'i skye bo rtag tu bral// phyir mi 'ong zhing 'phrad par 'gyur ma yin// shing las lo brul 'dra zhing klung rgyun mtshungs// zhes 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ gzhan yang dgra dang 'phrad pa/ gnyen dang bral ba/ nor ma rnyed pa/ kha drag zhan por song ba/ phyug po sprang por song ba/ mi mang po gcig tu song ba sogs dang*/ mdor na tsha grang bkres skom 'jigs skrag sogs mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pas mi yi lus rten 'di nyid kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du nges par bya'o// bde 'gro gzhan gnyis kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das te/ lha min ni lha'i dpal 'byor la phrag dog pa'i kun slong gis 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bshes spring las/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che// de dag blo dang ldan yang 'gro ba yi// sgribs pas bden pa mthong ba ma lags so// zhes gsungs/ lha rnams kyi nang nas 'dod lha 'og ma dag la lha min dang 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal kyang yod mod kyi/ de'i steng du 'chi ltas lnga shar ba'i tshe na/ yid kyi sgo nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las kyang ches lhag myong dgos te/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ lha rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i tshe// sdug bsngal 'byung ba ji rnyed pa// mnar med sems can dmyal ba yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod do// zhes 'byung*/ 'chi ltas lnga yang*/ bshes spring las/

lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying ba// gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni// sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed 'chi ltas lnga// zhes bshad pa rtsa ba'i 'chi ltas dang*/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga ni/ lus kyi 'od chung du song ba dang*/ khrus kyi chu lus la mi chags pa dang*/ gos rgyan las sgra mi snyan pa 'byung ba dang*/ mig gi rdzi ma 'khrab pa dang*/ yul gcig la chags pa dang lnga'o// des na lha la'ang 'chi ltas ma byung gong 'dod bdes g.yengs nas chos byar med/ 'chi khar sdug bsngal gyis mdun bsus nas 'gro ba yin la/ khyad par skabs gsum pa zhes bya ba gang du skye 'gyur gyi gnas kyang brtags na shes pa yin pas/ de ma thag dmyal bar skye nges lta bu yin na/ dmyal bar skyes zin las lhag pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal myong ba yin/ gzhan yang bsod nams chen po'i lha rnams mthong ba'i tshe chung ba rnams dpa' dkong ba dang*/ stobs che bas chung ba gnas gzhan du bskrod pa dang*/ gzugs gzugs med kyi lha rnams mngon gyur gyi sdug bsngal de dag dang mi ldan na'ang*/ rgya mtsho'i gzings kyi phug ron slar yang gzings la 'khor ba ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phen pa zad de/ shi ba'i rjes su slar yang 'dod khams kyi sdug bsngal mngon 'gyur du spyod pa las mi 'da'o// gsum pa 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ dper na phol mig gam 'bras shin tu tsha ba de la chu bsil ba btab na bde bar snang ba lta bu ni 'khor ba pa rnams kyi tshor ba bde ba ste/ 'di ni nam zhig pa na yang sdug bsngal bskyed pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya'o// de yang bshes spring las/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang*// las kyi dbang gis slar yang sa steng lhung*// 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang*// 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur// zhes dang*/

lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang*// tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa bsten 'tshal lo// nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus kyi// 'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas nas// slar yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur te// rang gi lag pa brkyang yang mthong mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin du skyes kyang*/ slar sa steng du lhung*/ 'khor los sgyur ba thob kyang slar bran mthar skye/ tshangs pa'i gnas nas kyang mnar med du 'pho ba dang*/ kun tu snang byed kyi nyi zla'i lha'ang mun nag gi smag tu phyin dgos pa sogs dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing*// mthon po rnams ni mthar lhung 'gyur// 'phrad pa'i mtha' ni bral ba ste// gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mdo rgya che rol pa las/ rga bas gnod par gyur pa'i gzhon pa cir mi rung*// sna tshogs nad kyis 'gyur ba'i nad med cir mi rung*// ring du mi rung mi gnas gson la mkhas pa cir mi rung*// zhes gsungs pa sogs te mdor na mtho ris kyi bde ba thams cad kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig go /bzhi pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ de ni theg pa spyi lugs su/ phra ba'i mi rtag pa zag bcas thams cad skad cig gis skye 'jig byed pa 'di la 'jog ste/ 'jug 'grel las/ mi rtag pa'i sdug bsngal thog tu 'bab pa dang*// zhes dang*/ rtsa bar/ 'gro ba g.yo ba chu yi nang gi zla ba ltar g.yo dang*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ chos kyi sdom bzhir/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba// zhes gsungs te/ de yang sdug bsngal dang po gnyis kyi sgo nas yid 'byung ba phyi rol mu stegs pa la'ang yod mod/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sgo nas yid 'byung ba ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos te/

dpa' chos kyi grags pas/ 'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas// sdug bsngal sgom par gsungs pa yin// nged kyi de yang rkyen las skyes// de yang bdag med lta rten yin// zhes gsungs/ 'o na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis yid 'byung ba ni 'phags pa min pa la mi 'byung ste/ mdzod 'grel las/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis// 'du byed sdug bsngal spu mi rtogs// 'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba yis// de yis shin tu yid kyang 'byung*// zhes bshad pas so snyam na/ de ni so so skye bo mkhas pa la 'phags pa'i ming gis brjod pa 'dra ste/ de lta min na/ sdom bzhi'i nang tshan zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal du rtogs pa'i so skye srid par thal ba dang*/ chos kyi grags pas kyang*/ de yang bdag med lta rten yin// stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi// sgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom pa bdag med kyi lta ba rtogs pa'i rten tsam yin par bshad kyi/ de rtogs pas bdag med lta ba mngon sum du rtogs par ma bshad pas so// lnga pa sdug bsngal de ldan gyi 'khor ba las nges par thar pa'i thabs la 'bad par gdams pa ni/ de ltar na/ spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ bde 'gror yang dang yang 'ongs te// bde ba mang po spyad spyad nas// shi nas ngan song sdug bsngal ni// yun ring mi bzod rnams su lhung*// zhes dang*/ slob ma la spring pa las kyang*/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rtag tu 'gyur ba yi// nang du zhugs nas bsti ba tsam la bder sems pa// de ni nges par dbang med rim gyis brgya phrag tu// 'gro ba mnyam dang mi mnyam kun tu 'khyams par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las kyang*/ 'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor// zhes gsungs/ des na sngar phan rang re 'khor ba'i bde ba la mngon par chags pa'i blo gros ngan pa 'dis phung du bcug pas/

da ni sdug bsngal gyi 'ba' stegs can gyi bde ba ltar snang 'di la skyon du lta bar bya dgos so// de yang*/ bzhi brgya par/ mkhas pa rnams la mtho ris kyang*// dmyal ba dang mtshungs 'jigs bskyed 'gyur// rnam pa kun tu de rnams la// srid gang 'jigs pa mi bskyed dkon// zhes pas so// gzhan yang sngar dengs phan chad srid pa'i mtho dma' kun tu skyes shing bde sdug thams cad myong tshul la yid bsun pa dang 'jigs pa skye bar rigs pa yang*/ slob spring las/ 'gro bar lan brgyar ma son 'gro de gang zhig yod// sngon chad lan mang ma myong bde ba de gang zhig /rnga yab dkar mdzes lta bu'i dpal gang ma thob pa// de yang gang zhig yod na 'on kyang 'dod chags 'phel// sngon chad lan mang ma myong sdug bsngal de yang min// 'gro bar gang gis tshim gyur 'dod pa de dag med// gang gi ltor ma nyal ba'i sems can de med na// 'on kyang ji ltar 'khor ba pa la chags bral med// ces dang*/ mya ngan bsal ba las/ yang dang yang du dmyal ba na// zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung pa// rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu la yang*// de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin// khyi dang phag tu gyur pa na// mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa// ri yi rgyal po lhun po yi// tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur// mdza' bshes rab tu bral ba yi// 'khor ba'i gnas su gang dus pa// mig gi mchi ma'i thigs pa yi// snod du rgya mtsho rung ma yin// phan tshun dag tu rtsod pa'i phyir// mgo bo bcad pa gang yin pa// spungs na de ltar mtho ba ni// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal// srin bur gyur cing rab bkres pas// sa lud bros pa gang yin pa// 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che nang du// de yis bkang na shin tu 'geng*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ de ltar na sdong po bkod pa las/ khyod kyis 'dod rgyus don med chud gzan pa'i// lus kyi sngon gyi mtha' gang dran byas te// de ring byang chub yongs 'tshol brtul zhugs dang*// bcas 'dir brtul zhugs kyis ni 'dod pa choms// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// da res dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin/ dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du brgal te/ gtsang rtag bde ba'i bdag nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang rin po che'i gling du slebs pa zhig ci nas kyang bya bar 'tshal zhes/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas gdams pa snying gtam gyi don po yin pas rang la phan 'dod rnams kyis ma brjed par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon 'byongs tshad ni spyir bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor bsdus na/ rje btsun rin po ches/ 'gro ba gang du skyes kyang skyid med pas// bsam blo thag gis chod na ci byas thams cad chos su 'gro ba yin zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// ༈ //gnyis pa thun mong gi thun mong ma yin pa la yang skyabs sems sogs bzhir yod pa rim par 'chad pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyu snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyu snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid la gnyis kyi dang po la/ skyabs yul ngos bzung ba/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro tshul/ skyabs su song ba'i tshad/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ skyabs song gi phan yon bstan pa lnga'o// dang po skyabs yul ngos bzung ba ni/ de yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu ni 'jigs pas nyen nas de las skyob pa'i skyabs don du gnyer ba yin la/ 'jigs pa'ang gnas skabs pa dang gtan du ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa gnyis yod pa'i snga ma las/ thengs re tsam 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che dbang phyug la sogs pas skyob nus pa srid mod/ phyi ma de ni rang nyid kyang 'jigs pa dang bcas pas gzhan skyob par nus pa lta smos kyang ci dgos 'on kyang skyabs gnas ma yin pa la skyabs su bzung ste re ltos bca' ba ni rang nyid ngal ba mthar thug pa'i 'bras bu tsam zhig 'byin gyis/

gzhan du dgos pa gang yang mi 'grub pas lam log pa zhes bya'o// 'o na gnas skabs mthar thug gi sdug bsngal kun las skyob par nus pa'i skyabs de su zhig snyam na/ de ni skyon kun zad yon tan kun dang ldan pa'i skyabs bla na med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum yin te/ mdo sde rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni// dge 'dun dag la skyabs 'gro ba// sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang*// sdug bsngal yang dag 'gog pa dang*// bde zhi mya ngan 'das byas nas// sdug bsngal kun las thar bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ skyabs sems bdun cu pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs// zhes gsungs shing*/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun// gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing*// gang la rnam pa thams cad du// yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa// gal te sems shig yod na ni// de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing*// de bstod de ni bkur ba dang*// de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs// zhes gsungs pa yin/ de ltar khyad par du 'phags pa'i yul la skyabs su bzung ste re ltos bcas na gnas skabs dang gtan gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol nas phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur bas lam log pa las khyad par du gyur ba'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya ste/ phyi nang gi grub mtha'i khyad par 'byed chos mang po yod kyang thog mar 'di nyid kyis 'byed pas/ phyi pa nang pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad// ces pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ skyabs su ma song ba la chos 'di par gtogs pa med pa dang*// zhes 'byung*/ skyabs yul mchog gsum la'ang rgyu 'bras kyi dbye bas gnyis las/ rgyu'i skyabs yul ni gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa'am gzhan rgyud la byon zin pa'i dkon mchog gsum ste/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid dag pa gnyis ldan mthar thug pa don gnyis phun sum tshogs/

chos 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag med rnam byang gi bden pa dang*/ de brjod byar ston pa'i gsung rab ming tshig yi ger snang zhing grags pa ste lung rtogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ dge 'dun rig grol gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams yin la/ rjes mthun pa theg chen tshogs sbyor dang nyan rang 'phags pa rnams so// mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin te/ de mthar thug gi chos dang dge 'dun yang yin pas so// de bas na rgyud bla mar/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi// skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir// zhes gsungs/ de ltar spyi khyab kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi steng du sngags la khyad par gyi yul rtsa ba gsum gsungs pa bsnan te drug skor du byed pa'i/ bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus/ yi dam sangs rgyas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams dge 'dun gyi nang tshan du 'du na'ang rtsal du bton nas skyabs 'gro dgos su byed pa ni/ byin rlabs zhu ba'i yul bla ma/ dngos grub zhu ba'i yul yi dam/ las sgrub ba'i grogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// de rnams kyi ji ltar skyob pa'i tshul yang*/ sangs rgyas la ston pa zhu/ des bstan pa'i chos nyams su blangs pas 'jigs pa kun las thar ba'i phyir chos la skyabs gnas kyi dngos gzhi/ dge 'dun la lam sna 'dren pa'i zla grogs zhu zhing*/ gsang sngags su de thams cad bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus te/ sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// zhes gsungs pas so// 'bras bu'i yul ni rang gi sems nyid dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs pa ste/ ye shes grub pa las/ dag thob bral ba'i sems sangs rgyas// mi 'gyur dri med chos dang ni// yon tan kun rdzogs dge 'dun te// yin phyir rang gi sems nyid mchog

/ces gsungs pa de'o// mdor na thun mong rgyu'i skyabs 'gros thun mong ma yin pa 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pas dkon mchog gsum skyabs mgon du khas len pa yin no// gnyis pa ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar/ lam ser po las gser gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pa/ rgya khyon dpag pa'i yul las 'das pa/ 'khor yug tu rin po che'i ri bo sman ljongs me tog dang*/ ni tshu la'i 'khri shing gis mdzes pa la rma bya dang shang shang ne'u tso khu byug la sogs pa skad snyan par sgrog pa/ ri sul dang ni'u sing gi ngogs su bse ru dang kṛṣ+ṇa sogs ri dwags sna tshogs rtsed 'jo bag yangs su rgyu ba bde ldan gyi zhing khams lta bur phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ baṃ dkar po las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgya mtsho dkar zhing dwangs la dri ma med pa rba rlabs dal bur g.yo bas gser gyi bye ma phyogs brgyar 'grems pa la/ lo 'dabs rab tu rgyas shing dri ma med pa'i gser gyi pad+mo bai ḍūr+ya ltar mdzes pa'i bung ba'i na chung glu dbyangs len pas kun tu gtams shing*/ ngang pa dang ngur pa dang thing ril sogs chu bya sna tshogs lus kyis gar bsgyur zhing mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bas bsam gtan gyi bying ba sel ba snyam byed pa'i dbus su/ gang la brten na dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i mtshon byed dpag bsam gyi shing lta na chog mi shes pa/ yal ga dang yal ga khre 'ur gyes pa me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas g.yur du za ba bsung zhim gyi ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte ba la/ rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/

phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol stabs su 'dzin pa/ lha rdzas kyi stod g.yog dang smad g.yog can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ do shal/ se mo do/ 'og pags drwa ba can la sogs pas mdzes pa/ ral pa'i zur phud la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i dbu thog tu brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ de'i mdun nas g.yas skor gyis til+li nā ro sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma yongs rdzogs dang*/ de'i mtha' bskor rgya bod kyi mkhas grub ris su ma chad pa dang*/ mdun du pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa la bla med rnal 'byor spyod rgyud bya ba'i rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams ma tshang ba med pas rim par bskor ba/ g.yas su seng khri pad zla'i gdan la mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sher phyin gyi pu tis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zlar bzhugs pa shin tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa la lung dang rtogs pa'i chos thams cad pu ti dang glegs bam gyi rnam par bzhugs pas bskor ba/ g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gang zag zung bzhi ya brgyad la sogs pas bskor ba dang*/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma dang*/

dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa sogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa lta bu bun ne long nger bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag nyid lus kyi bkod pa grangs med cing brjod du med par sprul pa'i/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du ngan song gsum/ rgyab tu mtho ris gsum ste rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sa chen po'i dreg pa ltar gang bar bsam nas/ rang gi byang drangs te thams cad kyang lus gus pas thal mo sbyar/ ngag gus pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig 'ur dir dir 'don/ yid gus pas dus 'di nas byang chub snying po la ma mchis kyi bar du/ re sa ltos sa skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams ma gtogs gzhan med snyam du blo snying brang gsum dkon mchog la ling gis bkal te mos gus gdung shugs drag pos skyabs 'gro byed par bsam zhing*/ khyad par sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'di rnams 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol snyam pa yid la byed pa 'dis ni theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro khyad par thon pa yin/ de nas ngag tu ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes 'don pa'i don/ bla ma zhes pa ni mchog tu gyur la gong na med pa'i don no/ sangs rgyas ni/ ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*// shes bya la yang blo rgyas phyir// sangs rgyas pad+ma ltar sangs rgyas// zhes pa bzhin no// sangs rgyas rin po che zhes smos pa ni ngo bo nyid sku yin la/ de dag kyang 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa'i gsung las/ rje ma lus kun khyab sgrib gnyis dag pa yi// bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la zhes dang*// ma 'gags kun khyab sku la zhing khams snang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa yi// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes dang*// dmigs med thugs rjes gang 'dul skur ston pa// 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa yi// bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku zhes dang*// zag med khyab gdal skye med chos kyi sku// snang stong zung 'jug 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// gang 'dul der ston kun khyab sprul pa'i sku// rje sku gsum bdag nyid ces gsungs shing*/

'di'i longs sku ni mtshan dpes brgyan pa nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku ni sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa nyid du shes par bya'o// de ltar go don 'phrod pas ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces brjod pa na de dag dmigs yul du byas/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku zhes sogs la skyabs yul gtso bo bla ma'i yon tan dran shes kyi dad pa/ skyabs su mchi zhes pas phyag yul gyi thugs rje bskul bar bsam la/ gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag 'tshal te/ chos sku la phyag brgya nas ngo bo nyid sku la bzhi brgya'i bar du ste thun rer stong phrag re bsgrub pa de 'dra thun bzhir bya'o// de ltar phyag byas pa'i phan yon ni/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar// yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam// yang na mgo bo skad cig btud pa dang*// de bzhin lan gcig lus kyang btud pa dang*// gang gi ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la// g.yeng ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas zhes// tshig gi phyag 'tshal brjod par byas pa yang*// de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di thob// ces phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka byed pa sogs kyi phan yon de ltar gsungs na mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyag byed pa la smos ci dgos so// gzhan yang phyag byas pa kho nas rtsa mdud thams cad grol te dag pa ye shes kyi skur rdzogs pa dang*/ de lta'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba sogs bdag cag gi bla ma rje btsun rnams kyi gsung las 'byung ngo*// de nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi blo chos su 'gro bar byis gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab cing byin rlabs zhu ba ste/ de la blo chos su 'gro ba'i chos ni 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang po ste/ de spyad pas thar pa'i snod rung du 'gyur bas na 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'am/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dang*/ chos lam du 'gro ba'i chos ni nyan rang gi nyams len/

de dag kun 'byung gi gnyen por 'gyur bas te/ de sgom pas sdug bsngal spangs nas mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// lam ni mya ngan las 'das pa der bgrod pa'i lam ste/ thar pa cha mthun nas brtsams te mi slob pa 'gyur gyi bar du'o// 'dir lam du 'gro ba zhes tshig nus kyis skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la ci tsam 'bad kyang lam der 'jug mi nus/ lam de rgyud la skye rung gi skal ba can du byed pa tsam yin no zhes pa ste skyes bu 'bring gi lam dang*/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba ni theg chen rgyu'i nyams len/ des 'khrul pa thams cad tsher ma 'byin pa bzhin du drungs nas 'byin gyi/ nyan rang gi lam gyis ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'am nyon mongs pa can gyi mun pa 'joms kyi/ shes bya'i sgrib pa nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mun pa spong mi nus pas lam yin kyang 'khrul pa sel ba min zhes pa'o// 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni 'bras bu'i theg pa'i nyams len gyi mthil ston te/ snga mas 'khrul pa dang ma 'khrul ba gnyis su phye nas ma 'khrul ba gnyen po des 'khrul pa 'joms par 'dod la/ de yang 'khrul pa'i dus ma 'khrul pa dngos su ma byung la/ ma 'khrul ba'i dus 'khrul pa dngos su med/ de'i sa bon yod pas sa bon la gnod pa skyal bas des 'khrul pa bskyed mi nus/ de la des de bcom zhes bzhag pas rgyu lam du byed pa'am spang bya spong ba'i lam zer/ phyi mas ni 'khrul bdo tsa na de'i rang bzhin shes nas 'khrul med du gtan la phebs pas ye shes su shar ba ste/ thag pa sbrul du bzung bdo ba'i dus thag par mthong ba dang*/ sbrul 'dzin gar song med pa dus mnyam pa bzhin no// des 'di la 'khrul pa spangs rgyu med/ gnyen po logs su brten rgyu med pas rang bzhin yongs shes kyi tha snyad mdzad de rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa ming tsam du ma lus pa'o// phyi ma 'di gnyis skyes bu chen po'i lam zhes 'jog pa'am yang na skyes bu chen po tsam dang chen po'i yang mchog gi lam du bzhag pa ste/

khrid tshul zhib tu spros pas dwags po chos bzhir yang grags la/ phyag rgya chen po'i lam rim gyi yang don rkang der gnas pas lam rim bsgom bya dang mthun pa'i 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa'o// rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs tshig rkang lnga ni skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang*/ grogs rdo rje spun la skyabs 'gro bgyid pa phyi mos yul gyi skyabs 'gro/ bcud kyi sems can kun snod kyi 'jig rten la brten pa yin cing*/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i sgyu ma'i rnam par rol pa tsam gyi phyir bla ma la brten pa ste/ des na snod kyi 'jig rten dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo zhes de de'i rang bzhin du mos pa'i brda' thabs kyis/ yi dam gyi dngos grub kyang bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten par song bas bla ma nyid kun gyi rtsa bar nges pa bskyed byed de nang dag snang gi skyabs 'gro/ mdor na snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rol pa las ma 'das shing*/ de'ang rang sems gnyug ma brjod bral chen por nges nas/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do// zhes pa'i brjod don gtan la phebs pa ni gsang ba don dam bla med kyi skyabs 'gro yin zhes dngos brgyud kyi bla ma dag gsung ngo*// rtogs pas bdag grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes sogs ni mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi byin rlabs zhu ba yin la/ 'gag don snying por dril na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'o/ de'i rjes su phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// zhes sogs kyis mdun gyi tshogs zhing dang zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa kun la'ang dmigs pa yin/ de yang thog mar rtsa gsum mchog gsum gyi tshogs la dgongs gsol zhu ba ste/

rtsa ba gsum gyi yi dam ni dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs zhes pas bstan te/ rnal 'byor ni zung 'jug gi don yin pas/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug rnams lhan cig 'dus pa'i 'khor lo'o// zhar las 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong dag kyang bzung ngo*// yang na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas/ 'khor rnams sems dpa' sems mas khyab pa'i phyir thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi sangs rgyas byang sems gnyis ka'ang tshig 'dis bstan par rung la/ dam pa'i chos ni dngos su ma smos kyang*/ de dag gi thugs rgyud rtogs pa'i ye shes su 'dus pas na shugs kyis bzung ba yin no// deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro ba/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las/ zhes gang las bskyab ba/ bdag dang 'gro rnams zhes pas gang skyob pa'o// skyabs yul la'ang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi ni rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /sogs te/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun no// de la bcom ldan 'das ni bdud bzhi bcom pas sam/ bha ga wan zhes pa'i sgra las skal ba dang ldan pa/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i skal ldan las mchog tu gyur pas sam sgra bla thabs su bsnan pa'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba ni ngo bo khams gsum pa'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus shing*/ khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags las rnam par grol byed kyi thabs ston pa ste/ 'dod chags kyis ni sdug bsngal bar byed la/ de las mya ngan 'phel ba yin mod kyang 'dir rgyu 'dod chags dang bral bas 'bras bu mya ngan dang bral bar byed pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya la/ gzhan ni go sla'o nang gi skyabs yul ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// zhes sogs te/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid sku yin pas na rang bzhin gyi sku zhes bya/ 'di'i dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// zhes pa la dbyibs kyi lha/

sngags sam yi ge'i lha/ ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya'i lha/ zhes phye bas chos dkon mchog kyang 'dir 'du/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la zhes pa dpa' bo dang dpa' mo zung 'jug tu 'jug pa'i tshogs ni rnal 'byor/ de ni/ nam mkhar kun tu rgyu grub pas// mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags zhes bla med kyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/ dbyings stong pa nyid kyi nam mkha' la mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes 'gro ba rang bzhin lhan cig ma'i bdag nyid du ston pa'i tshig go /'di'i shugs las chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams bzung ngo*// gsang ba'i skyabs yul ni/ stong nyid snying rje sogs te/ gsal ba rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa dang zab pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba gnyis gdod nas lhan cig tu skyes pa'am zung du 'jug pa'i sems nyid de'o// skyabs su 'gro tshul la/ ngo bo dang 'gro khyer gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob par 'dod pa'am 'dun pa'o// gnyis pa ni tshig ngag tu 'don pa la skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byed pa zer/ de yang yin la/ don skyabs de dag gi 'bangs su zhugs nas de las gzhan pa'i skyabs mi 'tshol ba la bya'o// de'i 'bangs su zhugs phyin de mi dgyes pa spong dgos pas sdig pa spong*/ de'i spong ba de ka sor sdom yin pas/ des skyabs su song ba kho na la so so thar pa'i sdom pa yod pa'i shes byed kyang thon/ de 'di'i/ bdag gi lus ngag yid sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan to// de'i rjes su skyabs yul rnams dpang por gsol ba'i tshul gyis sems bskyed bzung mthar/ mdun gyi yi dam rnams g.yas kyi sangs rgyas la thim zhing*/ de yang rgyab kyi yum chen mo dang pu ti glegs bam gyi tshogs la/ de g.yon gyi byang sems dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun la/ de dag dang phyogs mtshams kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong brgyud pa'i bla ma dang bcas pa rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdu ba'i rim pas sam/

yang na phyogs kun nas 'dus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de yang 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas rang dang gnyis su med par gyur pas 'khor gsum dag pa 'od gsal ba'i klong du mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam gyi skyabs 'gro'am 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro'i nyams len no// gsum pa skyabs su song ba'i tshad ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ rgyu bzhi yis ni skyabs su song ba yin te/ yon tan shes pa dang*/ khyad par shes pa dang*/ khas blang ba dang*/ gzhan mi smra bas so// zhes pa'i don/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan shes nas dang ba'i dad pa dang*/ de'i rgyur las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa ni med du mi rung bas/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i chos ni mi 'byung ste// sa bon me yis tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs/ de la yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ mdo sde dag las/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur pa/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa zhes sogs dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba sogs dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ zhes sogs rgya cher bstan pas mtshon pa/ mchog gsum khyad par 'phags pa'i yon tan dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sku gsung thugs mdzad 'phrin gyi che ba sogs legs par khongs su chud pa ni yon tan shes pa'o// khyad par shes pa ni nang pa dang phyi rol pa'i ston pa bstan pa de 'dzin sogs mchog dman gyi rnam dbye legs par shes pa ste/ khyad par du 'phags par bstod pa las/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas// bcom ldan khyod la skyabs mchis pa// de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod// skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan// zhes dang*/

mu stegs gzhan gyi gzhung lugs la// ji lta ji ltar rnam bsams pas// de lta de ltar mgon khyod la// bdag gi sems 'di dad par 'gyur// de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa yi// grub mtha'i skyon gyis brlag sems ldan// bsam brlag rnams kyis skyon med pa'i// ston pa khyod kyang mi mthong ngo*// zhes dang*/ lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod par/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin// ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang*// gang zhig rigs par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid kho na skyabs su 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ nang pa rang gi yang theg pa che chung gi chos dang gang zag theg chen rgyu 'bras kyi khyad par sogs legs par 'byed pa la bya'o// khas blangs pa ni/ sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pas nyen nas de las skyob pa'i skyabs zhu zhing rten du 'dzin pa ste/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyis rje bo zhu ba bzhin de la mi dang mi min sogs kyi gnod pas 'jigs nas skyabs zhu ba 'jigs skyobs kyi skyabs 'gro ste/ dper na rlung chen pos gru zhig pa'i 'jigs pas nyen nas 'phags pa gang po la skyabs su song ba dang*/ chung ma sha za mos 'jigs nas rkang lag drwa ba can la skyabs su song ba lta bu/ ngan 'gro la 'jigs nas lha mir skye bar 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro ba legs smon gyi skyabs 'gro/ de dag dkon mchog gsum tshang ba la skyabs su 'gro ba'i nges pa med cing*/ gtan gyi sdug bsngal las thar 'dod kyi blo med pas skyes bu chung ngu*/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du shes nas sdug bsngal de las rang nyid gtan du thar pa'i myang 'das thob 'dod kyi blo can ni skyes bu 'bring*/ mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar bzhag pa'i lhag bsam gyis skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyes bu chen po ste skyabs 'gro khyad par can du brjod do// gzhan mi smra ba ni/

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi skyabs dkon mchog las gzhan du mi smra ba ste blo rtse'i gtad sa gzhan med pa'i don te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ ljon shing bzang po rnams spang nas// ngan pa la ni su zhig brten// 'dod chags bral brnyes khyod bzhugs nas// mkhas pa su zhig ston gzhan 'dud// ces pa bzhin gyis so// de ltar khyad chos bzhi po tshang na skyabs 'gro rnam dag tu 'gyur ro// bzhi pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ mdo sde myang 'das las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la// skyabs su song ba ma yin no// dam pa'i chos la skyabs 'tshol na// 'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral// dge 'dun la yang skyabs song ba// mu stegs gzhan la phyag mi bya// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ lha gzhan la me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ mar me sbyin par mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ 'dul ba'i mdor yang*/ lha gzhan la phyag mi bya/ mchod pa mi bya/ bkur bsti mi bya'o// gnas su phyin na mngon sum du 'greng ste gtsug lag gi tshigs su bcad pa 'don pas de la phan gdags par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bslab ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten sogs la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes byas la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing bkur bsti bya/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la sogs pa mi bshig mi tshong*/ mi 'gom/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spongs/ dam pa'i chos mi spongs/ chos dang chos smra ba la gus par bya/ chos nyan chos la so sor rtogs/ thos shing rtogs pa'i chos rnams gzhan la ston/ chos nyan bshad kyi bar chad mi bya/ 'phyas mi gdags/ rnam pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos bsrung ba la bslab/ grogs mu stegs sogs dang mi 'grogs/ de dag la mi bsten/ bkur bsti mi bya/ dge slong dge 'dun la gus pas bsti stang bya/ rim 'gro bya/ bla mar bya'o/

de dag ni skyabs 'gro so so'i bslab bya'i dbang du byas la/ thun mong gi bslab bya ni/ skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ thos don yid la byed pa/ bden bzhi bsgom pa/ dbang po mi rgod pa/ bslab pa'i gzhi yang dag par blang ba/ rgyun du dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa/ lus srog la bab kyang dkon mchog mi spong bar skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya la slob pa sogs dang sngags thun mong min pa rtsa ba gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la gus pas sbyor ba sogs so// lnga pa skyabs su song ba'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ rgyal tshab chen pos/ skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don che ste// des ni tshad med yon tan tshogs 'phel byed// 'gro ba 'di la snying rje'i bsam pas khyab// mtshungs med 'phags mchog chos kyang rgyas par byed// ces dang*/ sna tshogs 'jig 'gyur 'jigs tshogs kun dang theg pa dang*// ngan song rnam mang sdug bsngal thabs min song ba rnams// skye dang 'chi ba nyon mongs las rnams kun las bsrung*// zhes dang*/ phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus ni spangs nas kyang*// mi yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la'ang sbyar ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo las kyang*/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus ni spangs nas kyang*// mi yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab bo// mdor dril na nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa/ sngon bsags pa'i las sgrib rnams srabs shing zad par 'gyur ba/ bsod nams rgya chen po gsog pa/ ngan 'gror mi ltung ba/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa/ ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa/

myur du 'tshang rgya ba ste phan yon brgyad yod par bshad/ de'i phyir shes na skyabs 'gro la chos kun tshang zhes rje btsun gong ma chos kyi spyan ldan rnams gsung ngo*// ༈ //gnyis pa sems bskyed la/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ngo bo dang dbye ba/ ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya/ khyad par can gyi phan yon nam che ba bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas/ rang nyid kho na de las thar pa'i thabs la 'bad pas zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i myang 'das su bsti bar 'dod pa ni gzhan don rgya chen po las nyams pa'i phyir don gnyer 'os pa ma yin te/ slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa// klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du// skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de dor nas/ gal te bdag thar byed na de las khrel bor med// byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pa// gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis zags 'thungs pas// ngal ba mang brten byams pa bsten pa de dag 'dir// shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro// zhes gsungs/ de bas na theg bsdus las/ 'jig rten don grub tshul la mthu med pa'i// theg pa gnyis po gtan du spang bya zhing*// thub rgyal rgya chen snying rje'i theg pa la// gzhan phan ro cig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa bkag nas/ byams mgon gyis/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bsal nas// sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min// de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs brten nas// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'das mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pas na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba de nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/

de thob na rang don rtogs pa mthar phyin gzhan don 'phrin las lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa yin pas de nyid don du gnyer bar bya ste/ de ltar na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa de thob byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin te/ rgyud rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi// ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung*// zhes sems bskyed med na sangs rgyas mi 'byung bar bstan la/ chu yi thigs pa bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar// rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yongs 'gengs pa ltar// de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog tu ste// rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes byang chub kyi sems dang por bskyed pa'i rgyun gong nas gong du 'phel ba las yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs pas na bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas phan bde ma lus pa'i rtsa ba tshugs par bya dgos so// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo dang dbye ba bshad pa la/ ngo bo ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa ste/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ sems bskyed pas ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces so/ 'dir gzhan don du zhes pa ni sems can thams cad rdzogs byang la 'god pa'i ched du zhes pa ste/ de yang rgyu byams pa dang snying rje rlabs po che las byung ba/ grogs sems can ma lus pa'i don gyi khur chen rang nyid kyis khyer ba'i snying stobs kyi lhag bsam dang ldan pas/ ngo bo 'gro kun sgrol nus kyi rdzogs byang thob par 'dod pa'o/ dbye ba ni/ 'gro bar chas pa ltar sangs rgyas thob 'dod ni smon pa dang*/

'gro bzhin pa ltar sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs byang sems kyi spyod pa la 'phral du sbyor ba ni 'jug pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems ni mdor bsdu na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi// bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas so// de dag kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi dbang du byas par shes dgos so// gsum pa ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// zhes pa la sogs pa'i cho ga lan gsum gyis te/ de yang dpe ji ltar na 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems 'gro ba skyobs pa'i mgon po rnams kyis/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid can bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi ched du sbyin pa la sogs pa'i tshogs ma lus pa bsags par nges par te gdon mi za bar sgrub par mdzad pa bzhin du byang chub kyi sems bla na med pa dang*/ dam par gyur pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi'o zhes pa smon pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin mod kyang*/ sems de bla med rdzogs byang gi nyer len dngos yin pa'i phyir bla na med pa dang*/ bskyed par 'os pa'i smon sems yin pas dam pa zhes bya ste/ don 'bras bu la smon pa 'jug pa gtso bas 'bras bu la dam bca' ba zhes kyang bya'o// tshul khrims kyi ni sogs kyis 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ de yang sems bskyed pa snga ma de byang sems kyi bslab pa'i grogs kyis zin par bya ba'i phyir bskyed pa ste/ rgyu la brtson par 'jug pas rgyu la dam bca' bar brjod do// de la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni mi dge bcu la sogs pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims te byang chub kyi sems gnas pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/

dge ba'i chos rnams bsdud pa ni phar phyin drug gam bcu sogs dge ba'i chos rnams sgrub par byed pa ste/ bdag nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su smin pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can la phan bde sgrub pa ste/ sems can yongs su smin pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ brtan por bzung ba ni phyir mi ldog par bzung ba'i don to// de ltar sems bskyed pa gnyis ka'ang kun rdzob sems bskyed de kun rdzob la dmigs pa'i phyir ro// bla na med pa'i zhes sogs kyis 'khor gsum dag pa don dam pa'i sems bskyed bstan te/ 'di ni sems bskyed pa kun gyi mthar thug pas bla na med pa dang*/ dmigs pa bral bas dam par brjod la/ bskyed tshul ni rang bzhin shes pa nyid kyis so// sems can kun gyi sogs kyis sems bskyed gnyis ka sdom pa yin par bstan la/ de yang phyi ma ni yid kyis g.yo ba sdom pa nyid kyis sdom pa'i mchog go /ma bsgral ba sogs tshigs bcad kyis de lta bu'i sems bskyed gnyis ka khyad par bzhi ldan gyi byams pa chen por ston te/ nyan rang sogs theg dman gyi sa las ma bsgral ba rnams byang chub chen po'i gnas su bsgral ba dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las ma grol ba'i 'jig rten pa rnams nyon mongs med par grol ba dang*/ dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung zhing mthar thug sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la 'god par bya'o// zhes pa rnams so// bzhi pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya ni/ spyir nyams su blang bya'i chos thams cad sems bskyed kyi bslab byar 'gro ba yin mod/ khyad par du smon pa sems bskyed mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i ched du/ sems can blos mi gtong ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i phan yon dran par bya ba dang*/

tshogs gnyis ci 'grub tu bsag pa dang*/ byang sems la yang yang blo sbyang ba/ dkar po'i chos bzhi sgrub cing nag po'i chos bzhi spang ba rnams yin no// 'jug sdom mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i ched du/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud dang*/ sems cad don byed gsum la 'bad pa'o// lnga pa sems bskyed pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur nas skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes ming 'pho ba'i phan yon dang*/ sdig pa shin tu mi zad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// zhes sdig pa stobs chen spong ba'i phan yon/ dpa' byin gyis zhus pa'i mdor/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ de las kyang ni lhag par 'gyur// zhes bsod nams rgya cher thob pa'i phan yon/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang*// chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba// chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mtha' med de// 'di dag mtha' ni rgyal bas mi gsung ngo*// zhes yon tan mtha' yas thob pa'i phan yon/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brten bzung*// zhes dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba'i phan yon gser 'gyur gyi rtsi'i dpes bstan pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos// legs par yongs su brtags na rin che bas// 'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams// rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan por bzung*// zhes rnyed dka' zhing rin che ba rin po che'i dpes bstan pa'i phan yon/

dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu skyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes 'bras bu mi zad cing 'phel ba dpag bsam gyi shing gi dpes bstan pa'i phan yon/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa bla na med pa yin te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang*/ srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'o// zhes sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ gzhan yang mdo las/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o// 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o/ zhes sogs yon tan gyi tshogs tshad med par bshad pas na gus pa chen pos rab tu 'bad pas bdag gzhan ma lus pa'i phan bde bla na med pa'i rtsa ba dus 'di rang du tshugs pa zhig ci nas kyang bya 'tshal lo// zhes bskul bar bya'o// ༈ //gnyis pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid la yang*/ sgrib sbyong gi thabs la 'bad dgos par bstan pa dang*/ thabs 'dir gzungs kyi khungs bstan pa/ de ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul/ gnyen po stobs bzhi bshad pa/ sdig sgrib dag rtags phan yon dang bcas bshad pa ste lnga las/ dang po sgrib sbyong gi thabs la 'bad dgos par bstan pa ni/ spyir mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab cing 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub pa'i rgyu ni sdig pa mi dge ba'i las yin la/ las de yang chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa ste/ las kyi ngo bo dngos ni sems pa yin la/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes pa 'du byed sems pa nyid kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dang 'brel ba na bsam pa'i las sam/ lus ngag gi las zhes bya/

lus ngag gi las gnyis kyang yid sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas yid kyi las rkyang pa dang lus ngag gi las zhes kyang dbye'o// de yang skye bo phal la 'byung nye ba'i sdig pa rags rims ni mi dge ba bcur 'dus la/ de dag spyad pas ngan song du 'phen zhing sdug bsngal dos drag la yun ring*/ gal te bde 'gror skyes kyang de'i sdug bsngal gyi cha rnams bskyed par byed de/ spyod 'jug las/ sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba dang*// 'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// 'dod pa rnams dang bral ba ni// sdig pa spyod las 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang rgyu'i dus su chung yang 'bras bu'i dus su 'phel che ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu ni sdug bsngal nyid du smin cing*/ las byed pa po las gzhan du mi 'pho ba dang*/ rang gis byas pa'i las gnyen pos bcom na ma gtogs nam yang chud mi 'dza' ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin/ de ltar nyes dmigs rnams dran pas bshags pa'i thabs la phyi shol du ma lus par 'bad dgos te// de nyid las/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar// sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi// ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ khyad par khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir sbyang bya dmigs su phug pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po don gyi ye shes 'phral du rtogs pa la bar du gcod pa sdig sgrib kyi tshogs yin la/ de yang ye shes skye ba la tshe 'dir bsags pa rnams dus nye bas sgrib tshabs che zhing*/ de'i nang nas kyang sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung sgrib tshabs che/ khyad par dam tshig 'gal 'khrul dang*/ mchod rten gyi blus zas zos pa sogs lam gyi yon tan skye ba la gegs che ba yin te/ dpe ras snam dri ma can la tshos mi 'go la/ dri ma de sbyangs nas dag pa na tshos gang yang 'go ba ltar rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib ma dag na ting nge 'dzin rnal ma rgyud la mi skye zhing*/
