sngags lugs gtso bor ston pa gnyis su bzhed pa las/ dang po gnyis ltar na sdon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs thun mong ba bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems sgom zhing bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa sogs blo sbyong gi khrid phal cher dang mthun pa tsam bya ba yin la/ phyi ma ltar na/ skyabs sems rdor bzlas sogs sngags lam dang bstun pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ khyad par 'od zer spro bsdu'i dbang gis sngar ma smin pa smin byed dang*/ smin zin rtogs pa gong 'phel du sgrub pa lam gyi dbang du byed cing*/ rnal 'byor ma sogs bskyed pa dang*/ khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor goms pa'i stobs kyis/ snang srid bla ma'i sku gsum gyi rol par 'char ba ni yi dam sgom pa sogs pas kyang tha mal gyi zhen pa 'gog phul che ba'i phyir/ bskyed rim gyi mchog kyang yin te/ yi dam las bla ma sgom pa bsngags pas kyang ngo*// des na smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi bskyed rdzogs thams cad sngags bla med dang nges par mthun pa'i phyir sngags gtso bor gyur pa zhes bya la/ zhi lhag gi sgom rim mdo dang thun mong ba rdzogs rim gyi sngon du 'gro bar 'chang ba las sngags lam rkyang pa zhes kyang brda' chad mi byed mod/ 'on kyang dbang rnon rgyu'i stobs can rten 'brel gyi 'jug sgo khyad par can las zhi lhag sogs legs par goms par ma byas pa nyid kyis phyag rgya chen po don gyi ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba yod pa lta bu ni de rang la ltos nas sngags lam thun mong ma yin pa kho na zhes kyang mi 'gal lo// kha cig smin byed kyi dbang yin na spros bcas kho na ba'am de sngon du 'gro dgos par 'dod pa yod kyang*/ rgyal bas gdul bya'i mos bsam dang bstun nas thabs tshul gyi 'jug sgo mang du gsungs zhes khas len bzhin du tshul gcig kho na dgos par 'dod pa ni gnad ma zin pa ste/ don gdul bya spros pa la dga' zhing mos pa'i dor spros pa sngon du 'gro bas spros med la bkri ba dang*/

spros pa kho nas dang por 'dul dgos su ma nges pa la cig shos kyis bkris chog pa ste/ don du na dbang zhes pa dbang don gyi rtogs pa rgyud la bskyed nus shig dgos pa gang zhig /de bskyed pa la spros med kyi dbang las spros bcas nus pa dman pa'i phyir na/ 'dir ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang nyid byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang du 'gyur zhing*/ de la rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang zhes bya ba dbang thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa nyid yin pas dbang gi go chod pa lta ci smos/ rtogs ldan gyi bla mas phyag rgya chen po'i skal ldan la dbang 'di las gzhan spros bcas kyi dbang gis bkri bar byed na nyes pa 'byung ba'ang yin te/ in+d+ra bhu tis ye shes grub par/ rtog pa thams cad rnams spangs pa'i// ye shes mchog bzang thob pa yi// rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur bas// dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya// yang dag ye shes kun ldan na// bris pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs gzhan du// dbang bskur ba ni len zhe na// 'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// dam tshig nyams pa'i sdug bsngal ni// lus dang de bzhin yid dang ni// de yi don rnams nyams 'gyur zhing*// myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur// shi nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni// bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag tu// myong la gnas nas 'phos gyur na'ang*/ gdol ba'am dman pa'i rigs su skye// lkug pa'am yang na 'on pa'am// skye zhing skye bar dmus long du// skye bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni// rdo rje ye shes zhes byar bshad// blo ldan de yis dbang bskur na// dbang bskur ba ni shes par bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa yod pas so// de ltar na yang rdor bzlas sogs 'od zer spro bsdu dbang gi gong du byed par 'dug pas na/ dbang med par sngags lam nyams su len pa'i dgag bya'i nyes pa 'byung ngo zhe na/ dbang gi sngon du sta gon dang 'jug pa'i cho ga sogs byas pa la nyes pa med pa'i steng du phan yon 'byung ba dang mtshungs par go bar bya'o// de ltar phyag rgya chen po lhag cig skyes sbyor gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid tshul cung zad spros pa legs par bshad zin to// rim gnyis kun gyi rtsa ba sngon 'gro'i chos// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang dngos sgrub 'dod rnams// lam mchog 'di la gom pa mngon brten pas// phyag rgya chen po'i sa la 'god par 'gyur// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i legs byas mthus// lus can 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol// yang dag snying po rig pa'i dbyings// thams cad mkhyen dngos 'grub gyur cig

/de ltar phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa mdo rgyas 'tshams pa 'di bzhin/ 7dpal 'brug pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa 7mi pham 'jam dpal dpa' bo ye shes snang ba'i gter gyis bris pa phyogs dus kun tu dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /
